name: Learn WASD Walk
summary: A deliberately empty locomotion workspace. Previous training logic and experimental history are removed; only the strict cumulative milestone ladder and robot input remain for the next coding agent.

examples.name: Inspect milestone evidence
examples.description: Open synchronized validation records, contact sheets, and proof videos produced by the persistent TK2 training task.

milestones.name: Passive stand · 30 s
milestones.passWhen: Zero actions, zero command, zero resets or done events.

milestones.name: Policy stand · 30 s
milestones.passWhen: Policy control with zero falls, resets, or done events.

milestones.name: Forward gate · 5 m
milestones.passWhen: Walking pose preserved with no reset.

milestones.name: Forward gate · 10 m
milestones.passWhen: Same checkpoint re-passes all earlier gates.

milestones.name: Turn 90° and hold
milestones.passWhen: Turn, settle, and hold without reset.

milestones.name: Teleop · 60 s
milestones.passWhen: Forward and turn commands without reset or frozen joints.

milestones.name: Four directions · 10 m
milestones.passWhen: One checkpoint clears forward, left, right, and backward.

milestones.name: Triangle path
milestones.passWhen: Joystick-style waypoint commands with no reset.

milestones.name: Rough terrain · 5 m
milestones.passWhen: Cross the small map without reset.

milestones.name: Mixed game gate · 10 m
milestones.passWhen: Terrain and obstacles with a preserved walking pose.
